prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” lawyer for every Chicago car-accident case — the right attorney depends on your case details (injury severity, insurance issues, fault disputes, commercial vehicles, uninsured motorists), your priorities (maximum recovery vs quick settlement), language needs, and budget. That said, here’s how to find the best match quickly — and a short list of highly regarded Chicago personal-injury firms you can contact for a free consult.

What to look for in a car‑accident attorney
- Experience with similar cases (catastrophic injuries, wrongful death, commercial/tractor‑trailer, uninsured motorist, DUI).  
- Trial experience and a record of verdicts and large settlements (shows the firm will litigate if needed).  
- Contingency-fee agreement (no fee unless you recover) and clear explanation of costs/expenses.  
- Resources to hire experts (accident reconstruction, medical, vocational).  
- Good client communication (response time, who you deal with).  
- Local courtroom experience and relationships with local medical providers.  
- Positive reviews, peer recognitions (Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell), and disciplinary record check.

Well-regarded Chicago personal-injury firms to consider
(These are established firms known for car-accident and serious-injury work — contact multiple firms for consultations.)
- Clifford Law Offices  
- Corboy & Demetrio  
- Levin & Perconti  
- Power Rogers (Power Rogers & Smith / Power Rogers & Smith LLP)  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard

Next step I can take for you
- If you tell me your ZIP code and a brief summary of the crash (date, severity of injuries, whether the other driver was insured, any police report, vehicle types), I’ll prepare a short, tailored list of 3–5 attorneys in your area with quick notes on their strengths and what to ask at a free consult.
